ThaioType upgrade your typing experience. Upgrade your on-screen Thai keyboard to ThaioType. Experience the best Thai keyboard for iOS yet.

Enhance your Thai typing skill by using ThaioKey keyboard for IOS. Our keyboard is especially designed for Thai typing by adding more accuracy, convenience and speed by words suggestion and prediction. 

ThaioType analyses your typing style in words or phrases, correct your mistakes, and predict what you are going to type next, which are suitable to all typing speed.

What do you need to know?

- Available on all iOS devices
- Predicting the words you will type right from the first letter you are typing, by analyzing your frequently used words and phrases.
- Save words or phrases you like to type by adding into your own dictionary.
- Suggesting correction while you are typing, whether there is any typing misspelled word or wrong word choice.
- Support abbreviations and suggest the correct abbreviation.
- Searching for possible letters to end the word you are about to type through KeyGuide™ function.
- Option to hide ฃ and ฅ keys on your iPhone, making it similar to the normal Thai keyboard.
- Adapting the keyboard version suitable for your usage automatically such as changing the keyboard to ‘Go’ when you are browsing, ‘search’ when you are finding friends on social media, and even changing into number pad when you are about to fill in your credit card number.

How setup your “ThaioType” keyboard?

Go to iOS Settings > General > Keyboard > Keyboards > Add New Keyboard > Choose “ThaioType” > Enable “Allow Full Access”.
